references.finding: Very large white serif masthead bounded by hairlines; tree, leaf and amber photographic ribbons occupy the lower field. Source brand and annotations must not be copied.
Alternating roof-shaped photographic chapter markers with italic numerals. Chapter labels remain separate editable text.
A single central roof-shaped leaf image, overlaid italic chapter numeral and a serif chapter name below.
The same chapter structure uses water imagery; this shared chapter grammar is an explicit policy rather than content-page reuse.
Black, moss and ember materials descend across the page. Large serif labels and fine oblique connectors organize materials without a card grid.
An entirely typographic brand architecture page: oversized two-line serif statement, hairline divider and restrained text groups.
A large clean product-photography pair and short captions sit against black, with a very subtle candelabra engraving at the margin.
A tall product still life balances a huge closing masthead. Printed branding in this product photograph is excluded from reusable crops.

excluded: all WENYE/WILD WHISPER source wording and logos
source colour codes and product names
limitations: Only raster slide references are available.

toc.designReason: Two roof-shaped product markers and italic numerals preserve the source directory grammar while presenting only the actual chapter names.

ending.designReason: A clean product strip opens the closing page, followed by a large centered serif sign-off and one brief original-text line.

content.designReason: The headline and first note occupy opposite upper corners. A tree ribbon divides them from a lower-left second note and an ember material plate.

contentVariants.designReason: The headline and first note occupy opposite upper corners. A tree ribbon divides them from a lower-left second note and an ember material plate.
One roof-shaped photographic specimen is the center of the page; two complete notes flank it beneath a full-width serif masthead.
Oversized white serif type is the dominant visual. Two staggered prose columns below create a typographic brand page without forcing a photograph.
A vertical left masthead runs beside a broad product photograph; two caption sections align below the photographic field.
A large photographic plate and a complete narrow article form the upper spread; a full-width oversized masthead closes both fields below, rather than sitting beside the article.
The two notes descend diagonally with moss and ember plates in the opposing corners, extending the source material-study reading order.
A tall serif masthead becomes the central gutter of two independent prose fields. The page relies on type and black space, as the source architecture page does.
Two numbered rows reverse the weight of the section numeral: the first leads from the left, the second closes at the right. Copy remains in its original order.
A black title label cuts into a large bright product panorama; the full original article runs beneath it as one uninterrupted reading field.
Two notes are stacked at the left, a tall photographic sample occupies the middle, and the headline is detached at the far right.
The first section opens across the page. The headline and second section then share a middle row above one low photographic horizon.

A broad opening column leads into two compact newspaper continuation columns. The exact second-section prose flows across the two right columns; the lower headline and landscape plate form a separate display band.
A masthead leads to a full-width first section; below it, a large product plate precedes the right-hand second section.
The whole article opens in a broad upper field. A compact two-line title then shares the lower field with a wide product photograph.
The first section is the large display passage at upper left; a lower headline balances the smaller second section beneath the right-hand photograph.

The opening passage, a tall central masthead and the reference engraving form the upper study. The second source section then expands into one full-width display passage below all three, changing the article from a narrow opening to a broad conclusion.
A vertical right-hand masthead accompanies three broad horizontal bands: first note, tree photograph, second note.
Two large italic section numerals introduce narrow prose columns. The differing numeral and body widths produce a literal two-part reading structure.
A tree ribbon above and green leaf ribbon below frame a broad article on the left and a two-line serif title at the right.
Two image-and-copy pairs occupy opposing corners, joined by a large central headline. The text is read from the upper-left section through the headline to the lower-right section.
A full article shares the left with its title; a product photograph and a large true page folio form two independent right-hand anchors.
The first section becomes a wide display passage above a material ribbon. The smaller second section and a detached lower-right headline close the page.
Two tall product close-ups form the page margins; one central article stays uninterrupted below a full-width serif title.
Two notes lead across the top, a centered complete product photograph occupies the middle, and a large bottom headline signs off the page.
An uninterrupted large reading passage is the main visual. A restrained serif heading and fine rules keep the page within the source typographic language without decorative imagery.

visualAcceptance.scope: Inspected reference/deck overview and every full-size page 1-30 from the actual isolated Linux HTTP PPTX export rendered by LibreOffice. Applied PM-calibrated whole-composition standard including primary images, paragraph continuity, hierarchy and cross-field relationships.
